name: Orça testing

permissions:
  contents: write

on:
  push:
    branches: [merge, dev_ja]

  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  APP_PORT: ${{ secrets.APP_PORT }}
  JWT_SECRET:  ${{ secrets.JWT_SECRET }}
  JWT_EXPIRES_IN:  ${{ secrets.JWT_EXPIRES_IN }}
  DBMS_TYPE:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_TYPE }}
  DBMS_HOST:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_HOST }}
  DBMS_PORT:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_PORT }}
  DBMS_DB:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_DB }}
  DBMS_USER:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_USER }}
  DBMS_PASSWORD:  ${{ secrets.DBMS_PASSWORD }}
  TYPEORM_ENTITIES:  ${{ secrets.TYPEORM_ENTITIES }}
  TYPEORM_SYNCHRONIZE:  ${{ secrets.TYPEORM_SYNCHRONIZE }}
  TYPEORM_LOGGING:  ${{ secrets.TYPEORM_LOGGING }}
  TYPEORM_TIMEZONE:  ${{ secrets.TYPEORM_TIMEZONE }}
  SILENT:  ${{ secrets.SILENT }}
  TZ:  ${{ secrets.TZ }}
  FILE_UPLOAD_DEST:  ${{ secrets.FILE_UPLOAD_DEST }}
  USER_UPDATE_EXPIRATION_HOURS:  ${{ secrets.USER_UPDATE_EXPIRATION_HOURS }}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:latest
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: ${{ env.DBMS_DB }}        
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${{ env.DBMS_PASSWORD }}
          POSTGRES_USER: ${{ env.DBMS_USER }}
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        # Set health checks to wait until postgres has started
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: 
          repository: ${{ vars.GH_REPOSITORY }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
          path: .
      - name: Using Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: 18.17.1
      - name: Installing depencencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Creating database
        run: cat sql/create.sql | PGPASSWORD=${{ env.DBMS_PASSWORD }} psql -h ${{ env.DBMS_HOST }} -U ${{ env.DBMS_USER }} -d ${{ env.DBMS_DB }}
      - name: Logging database
        run: |
          echo "=== All users ===" PGPASSWORD=${{ env.DBMS_PASSWORD }} psql -h localhost -U ${{ env.DBMS_USER }} -d ${{ env.DBMS_DB }} -c "SELECT id, email, role FROM users;"
      - name: Clearing/Seeding database
        run: npm run test:reset-db
      - name: Running test suites
        run: npm run test:e2e
      # - name: Pushing to target branch
      #   run: |
      #     git checkout -b ${{ vars.GH_TARGET_BRANCH }}
      #     git config --global user.name "Pipeline"
      #     git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
      #     git add .
      #     git commit -m "Automated push" --allow-empty
      #     git push -u origin ${{ vars.GH_TARGET_BRANCH }} --force
